question: Who started a cleanliness drive ahead of the national urban local bodies’ conference in Manesar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manesar Municipal Corporation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The cleanliness drive ahead of the **national urban local bodies’ conference** in Manesar was initiated by the **Manesar Municipal Corporation**.
 
• Manesar Municipal Corporation is responsible for maintaining cleanliness, sanitation, and managing waste in the region under its jurisdiction.
 
• The conference aimed at addressing urban development issues, including **waste management and sanitation**, making the cleanliness drive a significant preparatory activity.
 
• The initiative aligns with the **Swachh Bharat Mission**, a flagship program by the Government of India to promote cleanliness and hygiene across urban and rural areas.
 
• Municipal corporations like Manesar play a crucial role in implementing policies related to urban infrastructure and ensuring compliance with environmental standards.
